claim: `ucontrol build <x> <y> @micro-processor 0 @this` builds a processor whose config is this program: self-replication.
why: Community calls it 病毒逻辑. It is a design, not an error — but it is the first line worth seeing when you open someone else's map. Corpus: 9,232 programs use `ucontrol build`, 9,151 of them replicate; only 2 distinct programs.
